HowItWorks.title: Book in minutes
HowItWorks.subtitle: Eight steps from choosing a car to handing back the keys. No online payment — we confirm the reservation with you before the car goes out.
HowItWorks.metaDescription: Renting from A&A Corporation step by step: pick a model, choose dates and a pick-up point, see the full price, confirm the booking, documents and handover.

steps.s1Desc: Browse the fleet, view the photos and the details. Availability depends on your dates, and we check it when you book.
steps.s2Desc: Set the dates, the times and one of the pick-up points available in the system. Collection is scheduled at least three hours ahead.
steps.s3Desc: The calculator uses the rates in force: the model, the length of the rental, the extras you pick and the pick-up point. You see the total and the deposit before you send anything.
steps.s4Desc: The driver details needed for the rental agreement. Nothing is paid online.
steps.s5Desc: You click the link we e-mail you. After you submit your reservation, we will confirm availability and terms. A request is an availability enquiry, not a concluded rental agreement.
steps.s6Desc: Once confirmed, we e-mail you the required rental documents — as attachments, so you have them to hand on any device.
steps.s7Desc: At the agreed place and time, on presentation of the driver's documents. We complete a handover report: the condition of the car, the odometer and the fuel level — raise anything you spot before you drive off.
steps.s8Desc: At the agreed place and time, with all the keys and equipment. We complete a report on return as well, and release the deposit where there are no grounds to hold it.

Partnership.metaDescription: Grow a premium fleet together with A&A Corporation. Three forms of cooperation for private and business partners. Terms are agreed individually.
Partnership.title: Invest with A&A
Partnership.lead: We are open to cooperation with private and business partners interested in expanding the A&A premium vehicle fleet. Below are the three forms we discuss most often.
Partnership.vehicleDesc: You contribute a specific car. A&A handles the rental, the customers, servicing and the day-to-day running of that car within the fleet.
Partnership.fleetDesc: You are interested in a share in developing a larger part of the fleet than a single car, with an agreed scope and horizon.
Partnership.strategicDesc: Broader business cooperation around the growth of A&A: new segments, new locations, joint ventures.
Partnership.disclaimer: This page is informational. It is not an offer within the meaning of the law, nor a proposal to acquire financial instruments. We publish no rate of return and no profit forecast: the financial terms of each cooperation are agreed individually, after a conversation about the specific car and the chosen model, and are set out in a contract.
